cat <<'EOF' > /app/check_cert.py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify the self-signed development TLS certificate."""

import os
import re
import ssl
import subprocess
import sys

CERT_PATH = "/app/ssl/server.crt"
KEY_PATH = "/app/ssl/server.key"
PEM_PATH = "/app/ssl/server.pem"


def fail(message):
    print("ERROR: %s" % message)
    sys.exit(1)


def openssl_field(flag, args=("-subject",)):
    out = subprocess.run(
        ["openssl", "x509", "-in", CERT_PATH, "-noout"] + list(args),
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
    ).stdout.strip()
    return out


def get_details():
    """Return (common_name, organization, not_before, not_after, fingerprint)."""
    try:
        from cryptography import x509
        from cryptography.x509.oid import NameOID

        with open(CERT_PATH, "rb") as handle:
            cert = x509.load_pem_x509_certificate(handle.read())

        def attr(oid):
            values = cert.subject.get_attributes_for_oid(oid)
            return values[0].value if values else ""

        cn = attr(NameOID.COMMON_NAME)
        org = attr(NameOID.ORGANIZATION_NAME)
        not_before = cert.not_valid_before_utc.date()
        not_after = cert.not_valid_after_utc.date()
        fingerprint = cert.fingerprint(__import__("cryptography.hazmat.primitives.hashes",
                                                  fromlist=["SHA256"]).SHA256()).hex().upper()
        fingerprint = ":".join(fingerprint[i:i + 2] for i in range(0, len(fingerprint), 2))
        return cn, org, not_before, not_after, fingerprint
    except ImportError:
        pass

    subject = openssl_field("-subject")
    match = re.search(r"CN\s*=\s*([^,]+)", subject)
    cn = match.group(1).strip() if match else ""
    match = re.search(r"O\s*=\s*([^,]+)", subject)
    org = match.group(1).strip() if match else ""
    dates = openssl_field("-dates", ("-dates",))
    not_before = subprocess.run(
        ["date", "-d", re.search(r"notBefore=(.+)", dates).group(1), "+%Y-%m-%d"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
    not_after = subprocess.run(
        ["date", "-d", re.search(r"notAfter=(.+)", dates).group(1), "+%Y-%m-%d"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
    fingerprint = openssl_field("-fingerprint", ("-fingerprint", "-sha256")).split("=", 1)[1]
    return cn, org, not_before, not_after, fingerprint


def main():
    for path in (CERT_PATH, KEY_PATH, PEM_PATH):
        if not os.path.isfile(path):
            fail("missing file: %s" % path)
        if os.path.getsize(path) == 0:
            fail("empty file: %s" % path)

    if os.stat(KEY_PATH).st_mode & 0o777 != 0o600:
        fail("private key permissions are not 600")

    try:
        context = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
        context.load_cert_chain(certfile=CERT_PATH, keyfile=KEY_PATH)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        fail("could not load certificate/key pair: %s" % exc)

    if "BEGIN CERTIFICATE" not in open(PEM_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8").read():
        fail("combined PEM does not contain a certificate")

    cn, org, not_before, not_after, fingerprint = get_details()
    if cn != "dev-internal.company.local":
        fail("unexpected common name: %r" % cn)

    print("Certificate:      %s" % CERT_PATH)
    print("Common Name:      %s" % cn)
    print("Organization:     %s" % org)
    print("Not Before:       %s" % not_before)
    print("Expiration Date:  %s" % not_after)
    print("SHA-256 Fingerprint: %s" % fingerprint)
    print("Certificate verification successful")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF
